title: Senior Corporate Commercial Law Clerk
description:
About the Company
Our client is a well-established and highly regarded boutique law firm with a sophisticated commercial real estate and corporate-commercial practice; located in North York. The firm advises developers, investors, entrepreneurs, and commercial stakeholders on a broad range of complex transactions across Ontario.

The firm is currently seeking an experienced Corporate-Commercial Law Clerk to support a growing practice focused heavily on commercial real estate and financing transactions.

About the Role
This role will primarily support a busy commercial real estate and corporate-commercial practice with an emphasis on:
  • Commercial real estate transactions
  • Raw land acquisitions and development matters
  • Joint venture transactions
  • Commercial lending and financing matters
  • Borrower-side loan transactions
  • Related corporate-commercial work

The successful candidate will be someone who thrives in a transactional environment and is comfortable handling sophisticated files with a high degree of independence and attention to detail.

  • Support commercial real estate transactions from inception through closing
  • Prepare and review commercial lending and financing documentation
  • Assist with borrower-side loan transactions and financing matters
  • Coordinate and manage transaction closings, including document execution and registrations
  • Prepare and review agreements relating to acquisitions, dispositions, joint ventures, and financing arrangements
  • Conduct due diligence reviews and organize closing documentation
  • Liaise with clients, lenders, financial institutions, opposing counsel, and internal stakeholders
  • Maintain organized file management and transaction tracking systems
  • Assist with related corporate-commercial matters as required
The Offer
  • Competitive compensation package in the range of $100,000 – $115,000
  • Full-time, in-office position based in Toronto
  • Collaborative and team-oriented environment with exposure to sophisticated transactions and clients
What You Bring
  • Law Clerk diploma or equivalent legal education
  • 7+ years of experience in commercial real estate and/or corporate-commercial law
  • Strong experience handling commercial lending and loan transactions
  • Experience supporting borrower-side financing matters is considered a strong asset
  • Exposure to raw land and joint venture transactions is preferred
  • Strong organizational and file management skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong technical, drafting, and attention-to-detail skills

Next Steps

title: Insurance Litigation Associate
description:
About the Company
Our client, a prestigious international firm known for its expertise in the insurance sector, invites you to join its Calgary office. With a strong foundation of collaboration and excellence in service, this firm prides itself on cultivating a professional environment where innovation thrives. By being part of this organization, you gain the opportunity to work on impactful cases while growing alongside exceptional legal minds in a supportive, inclusive, and dynamic setting.

About the Role
As an Associate Lawyer specializing in Insurance Defense and Coverage, you will engage in diverse litigation activities that span client advisories, discovery processes, mediations, trials, and appeals. The position promises a wealth of professional enrichment, encouraging you to sharpen your advocacy skills and deepen your expertise in a stimulating environment. An integral part of this role is taking charge of legal strategies, crafting comprehensive pleadings, and championing cases in both court and mediation forums.

The Offer
  • Hybrid Work Model: Enjoy a balanced work-life setup with a minimum of two office days a week.
  • Competitive Compensation: Includes a monthly performance bonus potential of up to $2,000 in addition to annual bonuses.
  • Professional Growth: Access global training programs, mentorship, and career development support to further your legal career.
  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and robust disability coverage.
  • Paid Time Off: Flexible policies that empower you to recharge when needed.
  • Inclusive Parental Leave: Up to six months fully paid for parents, applicable to all paths to parenthood.
  • Referral Rewards & Engaging Culture: Generous referral bonuses and participation in vibrant social, volunteer, and professional events.

What You Bring
  • Education & Licensure: Law degree from an accredited institution with active membership in the Alberta Law Society or equivalent.
  • Experience: 4 to 7 years in private practice or in-house legal settings, focusing on commercial litigation and insurance law.
  • Skills: Exceptional legal writing, analytical prowess, and problem-solving creativity.
  • Interpersonal Abilities: Excellent communication skills and a strong aptitude for client relationship development.
  • Character: High integrity, sound judgment, and a proactive, entrepreneurial spirit.

title: Wills and Estates Lawyer
description:
About the Company and Role

A well-established, forward-thinking, and collegial law firm is seeking an experienced Wills and Estates Lawyer to join its Toronto office. This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in expanding and shaping the firm's Wills and Estates practice locally, while collaborating with colleagues in another Canadian office.

This position is ideal for a lawyer who values a collaborative environment, professional independence, and the ability to build strong, long-term client relationships. The firm supports entrepreneurial thinking, technical excellence, and practice development.

The opportunity is suited to a senior-level Associate, emerging Partner, or experienced Counsel looking to take on a meaningful role in the continued growth of a respected practice group.


Responsibilities
  • Advanced technical Wills and Estates expertise and strong client relationship management skills.
  • Deep knowledge of Ontario Wills and Estates law.
  • Experience developing personalized and comprehensive estate plans, including drafting Wills, Trusts, and Powers of Attorney to optimize financial outcomes and preserve family harmony for clients.
  • Proven track record of advising a broad client base that includes ultra high net worth (UHNW) clients, professionals, business owners, and blended families.
  • Focused experience on complex estate planning, trusts, business succession and post-mortem tax planning.

Salary
$150,000 - $220,000

What You Bring
  • A minimum of 5-6 years experience in Trusts, Wills and Estates.
  • TEP designation or working towards it would be considered an asset.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, meet strict and sometimes competing deadlines, and exhibit sound judgment.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.
